subject: Re: Gridline Systems — evidence retention schedule & control delegation
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@gridline.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@gridline.com, security@gridline.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Gridline RFI - retention & demonstrable evidence ask

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of Gridline's procurement due diligence we need a short intake on two items before our SIG submission: 1) a per-control evidence retention schedule (how long you retain logs, telemetry, backups, telemetry traces) mapped to SOC 2 control IDs, and 2) which internal RedWood (sic) control owners we can contact for sample evidence and short interviews.

Can you send a concise matrix we can attach to the RFI? Ideally: control ID, description, artifact type (log, config, policy), retention window, redaction guidance, and owner name + contact.

We have a tight window — final RFI due by May 31. Appreciate any accelerant you can provide.

Best,
Ellen Park
Senior Security Program Manager
Gridline Systems
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@gridline.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gridline RFI - retention & demonstrable evidence ask

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline.

Quick plan:
- I'll own the SOC 2 control mapping and provide a compact retention matrix (CSV + PDF) that maps SOC 2 control IDs to artifact types and retention windows.
- Kimberly will lead redaction guidance for customer-facing artifacts (PII removal, telemetry truncation).
- Jonas will be the technical owner for telemetry/infra traces; he'll provide sample probe outputs and a short evidence checklist for reviewers.

We'll deliver a draft by EOD May 24 and a finalized bundle (with a short cover note for your RFI) by May 28 to leave you some slack.

Attachments I'll include in the draft: redwood_control_map_v2.pdf (control->product capability crosswalk), plus an evidence_retention_matrix.csv. If you prefer a single consolidated workbook, say so and we will pivot.

Two quick clarifying Qs for your intake:
1) Do you need retention windows aligned to specific legal/regulatory buckets (e.g., FISMA/FINRA), or is Gridline looking for our standard operational retention policy?
2) Are you planning to request raw telemetry samples, or only aggregated/anonymized extracts for review?

Thanks — we'll get this to you on the timeline.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Assurance Programs, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@gridline.com>

Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 08:18:00 -0700

Hi Neha — thanks for the quick reply and proposed owners.

Q1: please provide your standard operational retention windows; we will note deviations if we need special regulatory alignment.
Q2: we will accept anonymized extracts for telemetry; procurement/security may request limited raw trace samples later during the assurance calls.

Two asks from our end: 1) can you flag any artifacts that require custodian permission or legal review before sharing (e.g., anonymized snapshot of customer logs), and 2) please include suggested redaction steps we can follow if we need to reproduce anonymization on our side.

Appreciate it — we'll watch for the draft.

Ellen
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: ellen.park@gridline.com
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gridline RFI - retention & demonstrable evidence ask

Neha/Jonas — starting the redaction guidance and evidence index now. Draft notes:
- Sensitive fields: user_id, email, ip_address, session_token. Recommended redaction: hash(email) and truncate IP to /24 for logs unless the sample is time-limited and approved by legal.
- Backups: retention default 90 days for full DB snapshots; 365 days for metadata-only retention. Sample backup manifests can be shared with filenames only; snapshot contents require custodian approval.
- Telemetry/traces: retain full traces for 30 days, aggregated traces (30d -> 180d) and metrics (1y). For RFI we can provide anonymized spans and a short verification checklist.

I'll attach a 1-page redaction quickstart in the draft. Jonas — can you drop a short example trace snippet (sanitized) and the directory path where telemetry is archived? I'll stitch into the CSV.

— Kim
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Ellen — attaching the finalized bundle as requested. Contents included below and in the attached stubs:

Attachment summary (stubs):
- redwood_control_map_v2.pdf (control-to-product mapping; 2-page summary)
- evidence_retention_matrix.csv (columns: control_id, control_description, artifact_type, retention_days, redaction_guidance, owner_name, owner_email)
- gridline_rfi_20280522.xlsx (consolidated workbook with a pivoted view for procurement)

Key highlights from the matrix:
- Logs (sys-event, auth, api): default retention 90 days; aggregated metrics 365 days; owners: Jonas Weber (observability), kimberly.park@redwood.com (redaction).
- Backups: metadata retention 365 days; full snapshots 90 days (custodian approval required for snapshot sampling).
- Telemetry/traces: full fidelity 30 days, sampled aggregates 180 days. We will provide anonymized trace samples via presigned S3 URLs (time-limited) or our secure review portal.

Legal/custodian notes: snapshots and any artifact containing customer payloads need legal approval. For RFI-level review we will provide anonymized extracts and a signed attestation that redaction was applied according to the documented steps.

Next steps:
- Ellen: confirm whether Gridline wants the bundle in a single workbook or as separate files for inclusion in the RFI.
- If you want short interviews with owners, propose up to two 30-minute slots between May 29–31 and we'll schedule.

Thanks — happy to iterate quickly.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Assurance Programs, Redwood Inference
